workshop: L4D2 3621862806 Corvus Butterfly Knife (Call of Duty: Modern Warfare's, CS:S knife slot)
name: Butterfly
note: The Point's execution knife (ClassKnives.csv). Open, 25 cm: the two handles closed together along +Y, the blade to -Y with its edge (the bevel and belly) on +Z and its straight spine on -Z, so tip [0,-1,0] and up [0,0,-1]. A stray quad sits 1.6 m off along the blade; keep_box drops it. The origin is the middle of the handles. Markers: Tip, Edge (mid-blade), Pommel (the handles' end).
